item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello, and welcome! Welcome to your weather report for Wednesday, November 25. It's Wednesday, right in the middle of the week. In Shanghai today, expect it to be dull and cloudy. It will reach 12 degrees, and drop down to 2 degrees. A bit parky today, as they say. Rain is very unlikely today. The sun goes down at 4:52 this evening, about 1 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? It's very cold. Please wear your warm coat, hat and gloves! Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be under a blanket of cloud, reaching 18 degrees. Still thinking about rain on the window this week. Has anything surprised you? That's all from the weather desk. Enjoy your day!
